prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Adding new screens (new_screen) was helpful, winning 5 tests (up to +15.4%), though 1 hurt performance (-7.7%) and 6 showed no clear effect.
Waiting screen info updates (wait_info) were helpful, winning 3 tests (up to +5.7%), though 1 hurt performance (-6.0%) and 9 showed no clear effect.
Layout changes (layout) were helpful, winning 2 tests (+7.0% and +8.7%), though 2 hurt performance (-3.7% and -3.8%) and 3 showed no clear effect.
Redesigns (redesign) and copy updates (copy) were helpful in 1 test each (+9.0% and +5.7%), though 1 redesign hurt performance (-7.5%) and most showed no clear effect.
Step reordering (reorder) hurt performance in 1 test (-3.8%) and showed no clear effect in 3 tests, while hints, notifications, and new flows showed no clear effect across all tests.
Predictions underestimated several large wins (e.g., predicting -2.0% vs +8.7% measured, +0.6% vs +5.7% measured) and overestimated changes that hurt performance or had no clear effect.

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Compact Layout Redesign: Redesigns the intro story screen into a compact layout with streamlined copy to help users understand the companion concept faster before choosing a path. (why: The mean time spent on choose_path step is 514s, indicating users stall before picking a path. Streamlining the story intro reduces drop-off.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Identity & Character Card Screen: Adds a new pet identity screen right before adoption certificate that highlights the pet's character stats and initial setup options. (why: Adoption has a high median time (89s) and users complain about pet configuration issues. Showing identity stats beforehand sets clear expectations.)
2: [home, redesign] Waiting Screen Checklist Layout Redesign: Redesigns the engine initialization waiting screen into a checklist layout showing setup progress for graphics and desktop permissions. (why: Mean time spent on home/waiting step is 2336s and 3 emails report the pet not showing on the desktop due to initial launch stalls.)
3: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Split Layout Redesign: Redesigns the final home intro screen into a split layout separating basic desktop controls from pet customization tips. (why: Support receives multiple inquiries regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing onboarding.)
4: [sign_in, redesign] Sign-In Options List Layout Redesign: Rebuilds the sign-in screen into a clean vertical list layout with clear data safety assurances. (why: Sign-in step drops 20.9% of users and 8 support emails mention missing or reset pets after signing back in.)
5: [adoption, copy] Adoption Stamp Certification Audio Effect: Updates the adoption certificate screen headline and action label to emphasize completion. (why: Adoption step takes a long mean duration (1017s); clear completion cues help users move quickly to final setup.)
6: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Render Progress Notification: Displays estimated render preparation time and tips for multi-monitor setups during desktop engine launch. (why: Users wait a median of 201s during the home/waiting stage, and support received 3 tickets about pets failing to show on screen.)
